small_graphs: Every directed matrix including loops, with every root, at N<=3
maximum_profile: Eight fixed main graphs: empty, complete, forward chain, reverse chain, diamond ladder, split cycles, bad root, bad edge; full reset/fresh matrix also runs
other_profiles: Directed families plus ten seeded graphs and four reordered replays; atomic errors and full-width masked fields
reset_probes_per_profile: 28, except 24 at N1 where three nonroot-update states and the middle nonroot merge are unreachable
fresh_recovery: Complete forward chain, every output field checked; N1 uses explicit self-loop
on_timeout: Stop; record TIMEOUT_NOT_RUN; no fixture reduction, limit increase or retry
